name: health_ai_agent
description: An AI-powered health assistant that provides visit summaries, symptom analysis, and lab report interpretations. Returns structured JSON suitable for generative UI rendering.

skills.name: Visit Summary
skills.description: Retrieve and summarize a patient's most recent visit, including provider details, diagnosis, medications prescribed, clinical notes, and follow-up instructions.

skills.name: Symptom Analysis
skills.description: Analyze reported symptoms to provide possible conditions, severity assessment, recommended actions, and when to seek medical attention. Always includes a medical disclaimer.

skills.name: Lab Report Summary
skills.description: Parse and summarize laboratory test results, highlighting abnormal values, providing reference ranges, and offering a plain-language interpretation of findings.
